title: Mari bar Mar Ukva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Chullin 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.43b.11) has Mari bar Mar Ukva speaking in the name of Shmuel. Hyman calls the name a textual error and proposes replacing Mari bar Mar Ukva with “Mari bar Mar said in the name of Mar Ukva.” He cites [Yevamot 76a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.76a.2) and says this is the reading of all the old printings, omitted by mistake in the Benveniste printing, as reported in Dikdukei Soferim on Chullin 43b, note Tav.[^3]

notes.text: The proposed repair separates Mari bar Mar from the next reporting authority, Mar Ukva. The original sentence reports Shmuel; Hyman’s abbreviated replacement quotes the repaired prefix. Benveniste is a printer’s name, not the word Venice.
The consulted Chullin text has Mari bar Mar Ukva reporting Shmuel. The Yevamot and early-print readings are cited as Hyman reports them.

[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2400&lang=en) quotes the Chullin wording, “Mari bar Mar Ukva said in the name of Shmuel.” In the different ruling in Yevamot, Rav Mari bar Mar speaks in the name of Mar Ukva, who speaks in the name of Shmuel. Hyman uses the latter chain to explain the wording he proposes for Chullin.
